import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the dataset
coffee_sales = pd.read_csv('data/coffee_sales.csv')

# Convert 'date' and 'time' to datetime
coffee_sales['datetime'] = pd.to_datetime(coffee_sales['date'] + ' ' + coffee_sales['time'])

# Set up the matplotlib figure
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 6))

# Create a line plot for total sales over time, separated by age group
sns.lineplot(data=coffee_sales, x='datetime', y='total', hue='customer_age_group', estimator='sum', ci=None)

# Adding titles and labels
plt.title('Total Coffee Sales Over Time by Customer Age Group', fontsize=16)
plt.xlabel('Date and Time', fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel('Total Sales ($)', fontsize=12)
plt.legend(title='Customer Age Group', fontsize=10)

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
